$comment: p95 thresholds per endpoint tag, in milliseconds, in the order api-load.ts calls the endpoints. Set on 3 October 2026 from three measured load runs: four times the highest p95 of the three, rounded up to a multiple of 10 ms, and at least 20 ms (docs/testing/PERFORMANCE.md). api-load.ts turns them into thresholds of the load profile; scripts/k6-summary-table.mts compares measured results with them; scripts/k6-thresholds.mts checks that the load profile gates on each.
